# Requirements Document: A shift of review cases

## Introduction

One expert moves through a short run of cases. These requirements describe every screen and every action.

Each criterion carries where it comes from. *modelled* means the sentence was computed by running the model. *proven* means Lean checked a theorem for every input, shown with its statement. *open question* means the model shows a problem and someone has to decide.

## Requirements

### Requirement RG-001

**Title:** Moving through a shift

**User Story:** As an expert, I want each action to do one clear thing, so that I can answer without reading instructions.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHILE the shift intro is showing and the shift has cases, WHEN the expert starts the shift THE SYSTEM SHALL show the first case.
   - RG-001.1, modelled
   - Read by running `Session.step` (model/Game/Session.lean:33), and checked in every engine by the vectors
2. WHILE the shift intro is showing and the shift has no cases, WHEN the expert starts the shift THE SYSTEM SHALL show the shift report.
   - RG-001.2, modelled
   - Read by running `Session.step` (model/Game/Session.lean:33), and checked in every engine by the vectors
3. WHILE the shift intro is showing THE SYSTEM SHALL do nothing on Call, It depends, Not my area, Next.
   - RG-001.3, modelled
   - Read by running `Session.step` (model/Game/Session.lean:33), and checked in every engine by the vectors
4. WHILE a case is showing, WHEN the expert makes a call on the case THE SYSTEM SHALL show the result of the case.
   - RG-001.4, modelled
   - Read by running `Session.step` (model/Game/Session.lean:33), and checked in every engine by the vectors
5. WHILE a case is showing, WHEN the expert says it depends THE SYSTEM SHALL show the result of the case.
   - RG-001.5, modelled
   - Read by running `Session.step` (model/Game/Session.lean:33), and checked in every engine by the vectors
6. WHILE a case is showing and more cases remain, WHEN the expert says it is not their area THE SYSTEM SHALL show the next case.
   - RG-001.6, modelled
   - Read by running `Session.step` (model/Game/Session.lean:33), and checked in every engine by the vectors
7. WHILE a case is showing and it is the last case, WHEN the expert says it is not their area THE SYSTEM SHALL show the shift report.
   - RG-001.7, modelled
   - Read by running `Session.step` (model/Game/Session.lean:33), and checked in every engine by the vectors
8. WHILE a case is showing THE SYSTEM SHALL do nothing on Start, Next.
   - RG-001.8, modelled
   - Read by running `Session.step` (model/Game/Session.lean:33), and checked in every engine by the vectors
9. WHILE a result is showing and more cases remain, WHEN the expert moves on THE SYSTEM SHALL show the next case.
   - RG-001.9, modelled
   - Read by running `Session.step` (model/Game/Session.lean:33), and checked in every engine by the vectors
10. WHILE a result is showing and it is the last case, WHEN the expert moves on THE SYSTEM SHALL show the shift report.
   - RG-001.10, modelled
   - Read by running `Session.step` (model/Game/Session.lean:33), and checked in every engine by the vectors
11. WHILE a result is showing THE SYSTEM SHALL do nothing on Start, Call, It depends, Not my area.
   - RG-001.11, modelled
   - Read by running `Session.step` (model/Game/Session.lean:33), and checked in every engine by the vectors
12. WHILE the shift report is showing THE SYSTEM SHALL do nothing on Start, Call, It depends, Not my area, Next.
   - RG-001.12, modelled
   - Read by running `Session.step` (model/Game/Session.lean:33), and checked in every engine by the vectors

### Requirement RG-002

**Title:** What every shift guarantees

**User Story:** As an expert, I want a short shift that can always finish and never shows me the answer first, so that a review costs little and my call is my own.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE SYSTEM SHALL cut a shift to at most 5 cases.
   - RG-002.1, proven
   - Theorem `new_respects_limit` (model/Game/Session.lean:63)
   - Lean: `∀ (cases : Nat), (Game.Session.new cases).length ≤ Game.shiftLimit`
2. WHILE a case is showing THE SYSTEM SHALL offer both It depends and Not my area.
   - RG-002.2, proven
   - Theorem `escapes_always_work` (model/Game/Session.lean:110)
   - Lean: `∀ (s : Game.Session), s.phase = Game.Phase.asking → (s.step Game.Event.depends).isSome = true ∧ (s.step Game.Event.notMine).isSome = true`
3. WHILE a case is showing THE SYSTEM SHALL show nothing that depends on the case's outcome.
   - RG-002.3, proven
   - Theorem `face_hides_outcome` (model/Game/Session.lean:161)
   - Lean: `∀ {O : Type} (d₁ d₂ : Nat → Game.Card O) (s : Game.Session), s.phase = Game.Phase.asking → (d₁ s.index).id = (d₂ s.index).id → Game.view d₁ s = Game.view d₂ s`
4. THE SYSTEM SHALL offer a way forward on every screen except the report.
   - RG-002.4, proven
   - Theorem `no_dead_ends` (model/Game/Session.lean:115)
   - Lean: `∀ (s : Game.Session), s.phase ≠ Game.Phase.done → ∃ e t, s.step e = some t`
5. THE SYSTEM SHALL let every shift reach the report.
   - RG-002.5, proven
   - Theorem `every_shift_finishes` (model/Game/Session.lean:129)
   - Lean: `∀ (s : Game.Session), s.Valid → Game.Finishes s`
6. THE SYSTEM SHALL move closer to the report with every step, so no shift can loop.
   - RG-002.6, proven
   - Theorem `step_reduces_remaining` (model/Game/Session.lean:91)
   - Lean: `∀ (s t : Game.Session) (e : Game.Event), s.Valid → s.step e = some t → t.remaining < s.remaining`
